title: Diagnose a Performance Regression Under Realistic Load
objective: Given a system behaving worse than expected under load, find the actual bottleneck using measurement and evidence, and prove the fix worked without breaking correctness.
whyThisMatters: Optimizing the wrong thing costs time and adds complexity with no benefit. This task is deliberately open-ended: nobody hands you the bottleneck up front in production.
evidence: Profiling or metrics output supporting the identified bottleneck
A written hypothesis recorded before the fix, including any hypothesis that turned out wrong
Before/after load test results for the identical workload
A correctness test suite run showing it still passes after the fix
acceptanceCriteria: A specific bottleneck hypothesis is recorded in writing before the fix is implemented.
Profiling or metrics evidence supports the identified bottleneck, not just an assumption.
Before/after latency distributions for the identical workload are both reported.
The correctness test suite is shown passing after the performance fix.
